'''Martin Heisenberg''' (born 7 August 1940)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Heisenberg_Martin/CV |title=Academy of Europe: CV |publisher=Ae-info.org |date= |accessdate=2012-12-27}}</ref> is a German [[neurobiologist]] and [[geneticist]]. Before his retirement in 2008, he held the professorial chair for genetics and neurobiology at the Bio Centre of the [[University of Würzburg]]. Since then, he continues his research with a senior professorship at the [[Rudolf Virchow Center]] of the [[University of Würzburg]].
Heisenberg studied chemistry and molecular biology in Munich, Tübingen and Pasadena. In 1975 he became Professor of genetics and neurobiology at the University of Würzburg. Heisenberg's work has focused on the neurogenetics of ''[[Drosophila]]'' (the fruit fly), with the aim of investigating the genetic foundations of the ''Drosophila'' brain by studying the effect of genetic mutations on brain function. In addition, Heisenberg contributed a number of essays on the topics of science in society, perception, as well as the question of the freedom of the will. He was elected as a member of the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina|Leopoldina]] in 1989.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.leopoldina.org/de/akademie/organisation/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis.html?tx_leomemberlist_pi1%5BshowUid%5D=436&cHash=0f05b09103835e4cddaaa18a084a348c&no_cache=1&sword_list%5B0%5D=heisenberg |title=Mitgliederverzeichnis |publisher=Leopoldina.org |date= |accessdate=2012-12-27}}</ref>

Martin Heisenberg is a son of the physicist [[Werner Heisenberg]], who is known for the creation of [[quantum mechanics]] and discovering the [[uncertainty principle]]. He is married to Apollonia, Countess of Eulenburg. They have four sons, including film director [[Benjamin Heisenberg]]. His grandson, Michael Heisenberg, son of Emanuel Heisenberg, is a psychologist based in Perth, Western Australia.<ref>{{cite journal
 |last=Heisenberg
 |first=Martin

 |issue=7244
 |pages=1052–1053

|pmid=19444190
 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Graduation Program – University of Western Australia (8 March 2021, 10am) |url=https://alumni.uwa.edu.au/file/documents/graduation-programs/Graduation-Program-Mon-8-March-2021-at-10am.pdf |website=University of Western Australia Alumni |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> He is the brother of physicist [[Jochen Heisenberg]].

== Distinctions ==
* 1986/87 Cornelius Wiersma Visiting Professor, [[California Institute of Technology]], Pasadena, USA
* 1989 German National Academy Leopoldina
* 1998 [[Academia Europaea]]
* 1999 Academy of Sciences Göttingen
* 2001 Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Science
* 2006 [[Karl Ritter von Frisch Medal]] of the [[Deutsche Zoologische Gesellschaft|Deutsche Zoologische Gesellschaft (DZG)]]
* 2007–2010 President International Society of Neuroethology 
* 2009 Doctor honoris causa Université Paul Sabatier, Toulouse
